desc:
The Dynastic Cycle depicts the socio-political status of the Great Empire of China, which flows through Dynastic Cycle Eras of stability, instability, and chaos.

Key to the Dynastic Cycle is the Mandate of Heaven, a form of Legitimacy held by the Emperor. If it is ever lost, the Great Empire of China will shatter - until it is again united by someone worthy to be the Son of Heaven.
name: Dynastic Cycle

phases.desc:
In this Era the Empire is focusing on growing stronger through looking outward: pacifying frontiers, expanding its reach through military force, Tributaries, and the Silk Road.

China enters this Era from either Unstable Era if enough Catalysts trigger. Therefore, to reform China to this Era from the … Era, it must first enter the … Era.

Only Nomadic and Herder Rulers take part in this Situation and the Gurkhan represents the most powerful ruler in the entire region.

desc:
An Earthquake is a type of Natural Disaster which causes grievous and sudden destruction in a small number of Counties.

Earthquakes can only occur in regions which are more prone to seismic activity.
name: Earthquake

phases.desc: Before many Natural Disasters, signs often precede the event. Whether obvious or subtle, these changes in the environment can offer warning. A vigilant ruler who pays attention may be able to act in time to minimize losses.
phases.name: Warning

phases.desc: As disaster strikes, the ruler's preparations will be put to the test. Regardless of efforts, fatalities are likely, halting progress in the area. The region will enter a period of instability due to the loss of Development and damage to existing infrastructure.
phases.name: Impact

phases.desc: After the impact, rebuilding the region, sometimes through a Great Project is imperative. A perceptive overlord will also take measures to aid in prevention, lest another Natural Disaster strike again.
phases.name: Recovery

parameters.text: Governorships in Disaster Area cheaper to revoke

desc:
The Silk Road is not one road, but a whole network of routes that connect the furthest corners of civilization to exchange gold, goods, and ideas. To have access to the Silk Road is to have access to all the riches of the world.

Different levels of access to the silk road grant varying gold bonuses, and may provide unique opportunities to unlock exotic Innovations. The amount of gold and knowledge traveling on the Silk Road will change depending on its prosperity, which is influenced by many factors, including wars, events, and China's Dynastic Cycle.
name: The Silk Road

phases.desc: Astounding treasures can be gained, the greatest profits can be made, and ideas and innovations spread the widest when times are good on the Silk Road.
phases.name: Exceptional Bounty
